# Adebled Services

> Adebled Services (RC 8111950) is a Lagos, Nigeria company with three divisions: IT Services, Aluminium Fabrication and IT Training. It serves customers nationwide.

## Divisions
- [IT Services](https://adebled.com.ng/it-services/): computer and laptop repair, RAM and SSD upgrades, network setup, remote IT support, IT consulting, web design.
- [Aluminium Fabrication](https://adebled.com.ng/aluminium/): windows, doors, partitioning, shop fronts, curtain walling, balcony railings, burglar-proof frames and custom work. Free site measurement; delivery and installation nationwide.
- [IT Training](https://adebled.com.ng/it-training/): computer basics, Microsoft Office, web design, cybersecurity fundamentals, networking, graphics design, CCTV installation, data analysis. Lagos and online; certificate on completion.
